name: Toast Mobile Menu
author: Toast Plugins

sections.description:
A fast, responsive mobile menu plugin designed for maximum flexibility. Easily customize it to match any layout, design, or device.

Transform your site’s mobile experience with a menu that’s as dynamic as your brand. Fully customizable, lightning-fast, and ready to go with just one click, it’s the ultimate solution to make navigating your site a breeze—while keeping users engaged and impressed.

Key Features

Seamless WordPress integration
Works with native WordPress menus, requiring little to no setup.

Fully brandable
Customize logos, colours, typography, and more to perfectly match your brand.

Advanced search functionality
Enable AJAX-powered search with live suggestions for faster discovery.

Flexible menu icons
Add cart, account, search, or other custom icons anywhere within your menu.

Promotional banners
Highlight offers, announcements, or key content with custom menu banners.

Rich, visual menu design
Go beyond simple page lists with imagery, icons, and advanced styling options.

Smart submenu control
Fine-tune submenu behavior to guide users exactly where you want them to go.
